title.en: A cowork workstation on a Paseo-derived daemon (work in progress)
title.zh: 建在衍生自 Paseo 的 daemon 上的協作工作站（開發中）

description.en: Work in progress: the Better Agent Terminal desktop UI on a daemon derived from Paseo, with task rules inside the daemon. Not an official Paseo or BAT build, and not a release.
description.zh: 開發中：把 Better Agent Terminal 的桌面介面接到衍生自 Paseo 的 daemon，任務規則放在 daemon 裡。不是 Paseo 或 BAT 的官方版本，也不是正式發行版。

eyebrow.en: Work in progress · BAT UI on a Paseo daemon
eyebrow.zh: 開發中 · 跑在 Paseo daemon 上的 BAT 介面

headline.en: Everyone sees the run. One client drives.
headline.zh: 人人看得到，一人說了算。

lede.en: BAT Cowork puts the Better Agent Terminal desktop UI on a daemon derived from Paseo and keeps the task rules inside that daemon. It is early: one of seven work packages is accepted, nothing is released, and it must not touch a production daemon.
lede.zh: BAT Cowork 把 Better Agent Terminal 的桌面介面接到衍生自 Paseo 的 daemon，任務規則也放在這個 daemon 裡。目前還很早期：七個工作包只通過一個，沒有任何正式版本，也不能接到正式環境的 daemon。

notes.zh: 非 Paseo 或 BAT 官方版本

meta.en: No signing key · no staging host
meta.zh: 沒有簽章金鑰 · 不連 staging 主機

label.en: Paseo write messages behind the send gate

title.en: One agent, several clients, nobody in charge.
title.zh: 客戶端一多，就沒人主導。

body.en: When a desktop app owns the agent processes, closing it stops the work. When several clients reach the same agent, any of them can send, pause, or resend, and nothing records who decided what. BAT Cowork keeps BAT's interface, drops its local sidecar and agent spawning, and lets a Paseo daemon own agents, worktrees, and task state, with the task rules next to the sessions they guard.
body.zh: 如果 agent 程式綁在桌面 app 上，關掉 app，工作就停了。好幾個客戶端連到同一個 agent 時，誰都能送指令、暫停或重送，也沒有地方記錄是誰決定了什麼。BAT Cowork 保留 BAT 的介面，拿掉它在本機的 sidecar 與啟動 agent 的部分，改由 Paseo daemon 管理 agent、worktree 與任務狀態，任務規則就放在它要把關的 session 旁邊。

quote.en: Viewers can comment. Only the driver gives instructions.
quote.zh: 旁觀者可以留言，主導者才能下指令。

title.en: What is in the tree today, tested only locally.
title.zh: 目前做好的部分，都只在本機測過。

intro.en: Everything below ran against a local test daemon with an in-process fake Claude client. None of it has driven a real agent yet.
intro.zh: 以下每一項都只在本機測試 daemon 上、搭配程式內的假 Claude 客戶端跑過，還沒有驅動過真正的 agent。

title.zh: 沿用 BAT 介面，保留授權聲明

body.en: The renderer is imported from Better Agent Terminal at 41ea2b1 under MIT, with TonyQ's copyright notice kept. A new Tauri crate uses its own app id, dev.teddashh.bat-cowork, with no updater and no BAT update endpoint.
body.zh: 介面程式碼從 Better Agent Terminal 的 41ea2b1 匯入，採 MIT 授權並保留 TonyQ 的版權聲明。新的 Tauri crate 使用自己的 app id（dev.teddashh.bat-cowork），沒有自動更新，也不連 BAT 的更新端點。

title.en: A read-only view of a daemon

body.en: The browser shell takes the daemon's WebSocket address as a query parameter and reads workspaces, files, diff, branch, and commit history. The read port has no create or send method, and PTY writes throw.
body.zh: 瀏覽器版用網址參數指定 daemon 的 WebSocket 位址，讀取工作區、檔案、diff、分支與 commit 紀錄。讀取埠沒有建立或送出的方法，PTY 寫入一律丟出錯誤。

body.en: Only the driver can instruct, pause, cancel, or release a paused task. Viewers can comment and propose. The daemon stamps each event with the connection's client id, and a takeover holds sends until the current writer settles.
body.zh: 只有主導者能下指令、暫停、取消，或讓暫停的任務繼續；旁觀者可以留言與提案。daemon 會在每個事件蓋上該連線的 client id；有人接手時，會先暫停送出，等目前的寫入者收尾。

body.en: Sends to a managed agent go through authorizeCoworkWrite. A stale revision, an old epoch, a paused task, the wrong writer, or a repeated message id is refused. Unmanaged agents keep the stock Paseo path.
body.zh: 送給受管 agent 的訊息都要先通過 authorizeCoworkWrite。revision 過時、epoch 舊了、任務暫停中、寫入者不對，或 message id 重複，一律拒絕。未受管的 agent 照走 Paseo 原本的路徑。

title.zh: 重啟後還在的任務帳本

body.en: Tasks are written to {paseoHome}/cowork/tasks.json and restored when the daemon starts. Each write goes to a synced temp file that is then renamed over the journal, so a crash leaves the old copy or the new one, never half of each. A paused task stays held. A command that was in flight becomes unknown until the driver acknowledges it, and it is not resent.
body.zh: 任務寫在 {paseoHome}/cowork/tasks.json，daemon 啟動時還原。每次寫入都先寫到同步到磁碟的暫存檔，再改名蓋過帳本，所以中途當掉時留下的是舊版或新版，不會是各一半。暫停中的任務維持暫停；重啟前還在執行的指令會標成 unknown，要等主導者確認，而且不會重送。

title.zh: 有新 commit 才算完成

body.en: When a managed turn ends, the task is verified only if HEAD moved past the last verified commit and the tree is clean. Each failed check counts a rework attempt, and after two the task becomes a blocker. No test result feeds this yet.
body.zh: 受管的回合結束時，只有 HEAD 越過上一個已驗證的 commit、而且工作目錄是乾淨的，任務才算 verified。每次檢查沒過就記一次重做，滿兩次後任務就標成卡關。目前還沒有接上測試結果。

title.en: BAT on the outside, Paseo underneath.
title.zh: 外面是 BAT，底下是 Paseo。

intro.en: The desktop is a client. The daemon owns agents, worktrees, and task state, and the cowork rules run inside it. Paseo's server, client, protocol, and CLI stay on their upstream paths, and the cowork code is wired in through seven upstream files: 237 lines added, one removed.
intro.zh: 桌面端只是客戶端。agent、worktree 與任務狀態都歸 daemon 管，協作規則也在 daemon 裡執行。Paseo 的 server、client、協定與 CLI 都留在上游原本的路徑，協作程式碼只透過七個上游檔案接進來：新增 237 行，刪除 1 行。

lines.en: Tauri shell does not compile yet
Tests use a fake Claude client
lines.zh: 測試用假的 Claude 客戶端
由 daemon 建立的 worktree

items.en: Not an official Paseo or BAT build, and not a release
items.zh: 不是 Paseo 或 BAT 的官方版本，也不是正式發行版

items.en: No signing key, no updater, no staging host
items.zh: 沒有簽章金鑰、沒有自動更新，也不連 staging 主機

items.en: BAT host calls that are not ported throw instead of half working
items.zh: 還沒移植的 BAT 主機功能直接丟出錯誤，不做半套

items.en: No provider dispatch until a real CLI contract test passes
items.zh: 真正的 CLI 合約測試通過之前，不派工給任何供應者

items.en: Cutover stays closed while any package is not accepted
items.zh: 只要還有工作包沒通過，就不切換上線

title.en: Why it is built this way.
Fork the daemon, keep its paths

body.en: Paseo's server, client, protocol, and CLI stay where upstream keeps them, and the cowork code lives in new folders, so upstream changes stay easy to compare. The cost: the rules hook into Paseo's Session handler instead of owning the flow.
body.zh: Paseo 的 server、client、協定與 CLI 都留在上游原本的位置，協作程式碼放在新的資料夾，和上游比對差異比較容易。代價是協作規則得掛在 Paseo 的 Session 處理流程上，而不是自己掌控整個流程。

title.en: Rules in the daemon, not a second service
title.zh: 規則放在 daemon 裡，不另開服務

body.en: Task rules run in the same process as the sessions they guard. bat-agent-connector's Python task daemon is a behavior reference only and is not vendored, so there is one owner of task state and no second ledger to reconcile.
body.zh: 任務規則和它要把關的 session 跑在同一個程式裡。bat-agent-connector 的 Python 任務服務只當行為參考，沒有複製進來，所以任務狀態只有一個擁有者，不會有第二本帳要對。

body.en: BAT host calls that are not ported throw UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY, every provider is marked not admitted, and ungated ingress throws. The UI shows less, but nothing quietly half works.
body.zh: 還沒移植的 BAT 主機呼叫一律丟出 UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY，每個供應者都標成未獲准，沒有關卡的入口也直接丟錯。介面能顯示的東西變少，但不會有功能悄悄只做一半。

title.en: The gate is a file a test reads
title.zh: 發行關卡是一個由測試把關的檔案

body.en: RELEASE-GATE.md is plain text. w6-release-gate.test.ts fails if it stops saying Not a release, if cutover opens, or if any package other than W0 is marked accepted, so changing the status means changing a test too.
body.zh: RELEASE-GATE.md 是純文字檔。只要它不再寫著 Not a release、切換被打開，或 W0 以外的工作包被標成 accepted，w6-release-gate.test.ts 就會失敗，所以要改狀態，也得一起改測試。

title.en: Read the gate, then run the tests.

intro.en: There is nothing to install as a product. In a clone of the repo, the task rule and desktop host suites need only Node (24 was used here) and no npm install. The client boundary tests and the server-side cowork tests run under Vitest and need the Paseo workspace install (npm ci at the repo root).
intro.zh: 目前沒有可以安裝的產品。在 clone 下來的 repo 裡，任務規則與桌面主機這兩組測試只需要 Node（這裡用的是 24 版），不用 npm install。客戶端邊界測試與 server 端的協作測試跑在 Vitest 上，要先在 repo 根目錄執行 npm ci，裝好整個 Paseo workspace。

body.en: The reducer, dispatch policy, ingress table, and UI parity rows.
body.zh: 涵蓋 reducer、派工規則、ingress 對照表與介面對等清單。

title.zh: 唯讀客戶端邊界：7 個測試

body.en: From the repo root, after npm ci. Runs under Vitest and checks that writes are not reachable and auth headers stay in one module.
body.zh: 從 repo 根目錄執行，要先跑過 npm ci。測試跑在 Vitest 上，確認寫入方法拿不到，驗證標頭也只在一個模組裡處理。

steps.code:
cd packages/client
npx vitest run src/cowork

title.zh: 桌面主機的拒絕行為：5 個測試

body.en: From the repo root. Unported BAT calls must throw, and reads must go through the daemon port.
body.zh: 從 repo 根目錄執行。還沒移植的 BAT 呼叫必須丟出錯誤，讀取也必須經過 daemon 的讀取埠。

intro.en: Work began on 2026-09-30, and the tree is still changing quickly. There are no tags or releases. CI on main runs Paseo's suites and the cowork tests; a few tests inherited from Paseo fail now and then and pass on a rerun. Paseo is by Mohamed Boudra and contributors; BAT is by TonyQ. This is not an official build of either.
intro.zh: 2026 年 9 月 30 日才開始，程式碼還在快速變動。沒有任何 tag 或正式版本。main 的 CI 會跑 Paseo 原有的測試與協作測試；有幾個從 Paseo 帶來的測試偶爾失敗，重跑就會通過。Paseo 的作者是 Mohamed Boudra 與其貢獻者，BAT 的作者是 TonyQ；本專案不是兩者的官方版本。

works_title.en: Works on a local test daemon
works_title.zh: 在本機測試 daemon 上可用

works.en: W0 accepted the original Paseo snapshot at 53ee9cd, upstream-lock.json, third-party notices, and the inventories in cowork-core. This tree now follows cf2b3f4
works.zh: W0 已通過原本的 Paseo 53ee9cd 快照、upstream-lock.json、第三方聲明，以及 cowork-core 裡的各項清單。目前這棵樹跟到 cf2b3f4

works.en: Two clients see one run; a repeated message id does not start a second turn; a daemon-made worktree receives the commit
works.zh: 兩個客戶端看到同一次執行；重複的 message id 不會開第二輪；commit 落在 daemon 建立的 worktree

works.en: Pause, takeover, rework, and restart paths in the task reducer, with a journal that survives a daemon restart
works.zh: 任務 reducer 的暫停、接手、重做與重啟流程，帳本在 daemon 重啟後仍在

works.en: A browser shell that reads workspaces, files, diff, and commit history from a local daemon
works.zh: 瀏覽器版可以從本機 daemon 讀取工作區、檔案、diff 與 commit 紀錄

works.en: 29 cowork tests pass in a local run and in CI: 17 task core and 5 desktop host that need no install, plus 7 client boundary under Vitest
works.zh: 29 個協作測試在本機與 CI 都通過：不需安裝的任務核心 17 個、桌面主機 5 個，加上跑在 Vitest 上的客戶端邊界 7 個

limits_title.en: Not done, and not safe yet

limits.en: Not a release: no tags, no signing key, no updater. Do not point it at a production daemon or an existing BAT session
limits.zh: 不是正式版本：沒有 tag、沒有簽章金鑰、沒有自動更新。不要把它接到正式環境的 daemon 或既有的 BAT session

limits.en: The Tauri shell has not been built: the one compile attempt stopped in glib-sys because pkg-config was missing, so there is no desktop window yet
limits.zh: Tauri 版還沒建置成功：唯一一次編譯在 glib-sys 就失敗了（環境裡沒有 pkg-config），所以還沒有桌面視窗

limits.en: No agent provider is admitted: Claude, Codex, and Grok stay closed, and every turn in the tests comes from a fake Claude client
limits.zh: 沒有任何 agent 供應者獲准：Claude、Codex、Grok 都還關著，測試裡的每一輪都來自假的 Claude 客戶端

limits.en: Only 2 of Paseo's 90 inbound write messages pass the cowork gate; the other 88 are not wired
limits.zh: Paseo 的 90 種寫入訊息裡，只有 2 種經過協作關卡，其餘 88 種還沒接上

limits.en: No client message opens a task or sends an instruction yet, the terminal is refused, and the journal is still one JSON file rewritten in full on every event
limits.zh: 還沒有客戶端訊息能開任務或下指令，終端機也被拒絕；帳本仍是一個每次事件都整份重寫的 JSON 檔

limits.en: Workspace scope is an upstream gap: Paseo grants are daemon-wide, and file preview accepts any file the daemon can read
limits.zh: 工作區範圍是上游的缺口：Paseo 的授權是整個 daemon 層級，檔案預覽也接受 daemon 讀得到的任何檔案

heading.en: Where the fork sits on Paseo
heading.zh: 這個 fork 怎麼接上 Paseo

intro.en: The BAT desktop is a client. The Paseo daemon owns agents, worktrees, and the cowork rules.
intro.zh: BAT 桌面端是客戶端。agent、worktree 與協作規則都歸 Paseo daemon。

note.en: The renderer is BAT's MIT UI at 41ea2b1, and the new Tauri shell has not compiled.
note.zh: 介面是 BAT 在 41ea2b1 的 MIT UI，新的 Tauri 殼還沒編譯成功。

note.en: The browser shell can read workspaces, files, diff, and commits, but it has no create or send, and PTY calls throw.
note.zh: 瀏覽器殼可讀工作區、檔案、diff 與 commit，但沒有建立或送出，PTY 呼叫會丟出錯誤。

note.en: Cowork rules run in the Paseo process, wired through seven upstream files.
note.zh: 協作規則跑在 Paseo 行程裡，透過七個上游檔案接進來。

note.en: Claude, Codex, and Grok are not admitted, and tests use a fake Claude client.
note.zh: Claude、Codex 與 Grok 都未獲准，測試用的是假的 Claude 客戶端。

caption.en: bat-cowork keeps Paseo's server, client, protocol, and CLI on their upstream paths and adds the BAT renderer, cowork-core, and the daemon cowork folder. Seven upstream files wire that in: 237 lines added and one removed. The Tauri crate uses its own app id and has not compiled, so there is no desktop window. The browser shell can read a local daemon and has no create or send method. PTY calls throw. No provider is admitted for dispatch.
caption.zh: bat-cowork 把 Paseo 的 server、client、協定與 CLI 留在上游路徑，另外加上 BAT 的介面、cowork-core，以及 daemon 裡的 cowork 資料夾。這是透過七個上游檔案接進來的：新增 237 行，刪除 1 行。Tauri crate 用自己的 app id，而且還沒編譯成功，所以沒有桌面視窗。瀏覽器殼可以讀本機 daemon，沒有建立或送出的方法。PTY 呼叫會丟出錯誤。沒有供應者獲准派工。

heading.en: Who may act on a task

intro.en: Viewers can comment. Control actions require the driver, and an instruction is not on the wire.
intro.zh: 旁觀者可以留言。控制動作必須是主導者，而且線上訊息沒有指令這個動作。

note.en: Append accepts a comment or a proposal, and the daemon stamps the connection client id.
note.zh: 附加訊息接受留言或提案，daemon 會蓋上這條連線的 client id。

note.en: Pause, cancel, takeover, and release are rejected unless that client id is the driver.
note.zh: 暫停、取消、接手與放開，如果 client id 不是主導者，就會被拒絕。

caption.en: cowork.tasks.append accepts comment, proposal, and control. The actor stored on the event is the session client id, not a name from the payload. Pause, cancel, takeover, and release are rejected when that id is not the driver. The message has no instruction action, nothing consumes a dispatch intent, and no client message calls openTask.
caption.zh: cowork.tasks.append 接受 comment、proposal 與 control。事件上記下的行為者是 session 的 client id，不是訊息內容裡的名字。暫停、取消、接手與放開，如果這個 id 不是主導者就會被拒絕。這個訊息沒有 instruction 動作，沒有人取用 dispatch intent，也沒有客戶端訊息會呼叫 openTask。

intro.en: Two Paseo write messages call the gate for a managed target. The other 88 write messages do not.
intro.zh: 兩種 Paseo 寫入訊息會對受管目標呼叫關卡。其餘 88 種寫入訊息不會。

note.en: A stale revision or an old control epoch is refused.
note.zh: 過時的 revision，或舊的 control epoch，都會被拒絕。

note.en: The wrong writer, a paused task, or a takeover that has not settled is refused.
note.zh: 寫入者不對、任務暫停中，或接手還沒收尾，都會被拒絕。

note.en: A command id that was already dispatched does not start a second turn.
note.zh: 已經派過的 command id 不會再開第二輪。

note.en: Only send and create call this gate, and an unmanaged target keeps the stock Paseo path.
note.zh: 只有送出與建立會呼叫這個關卡，未受管的目標仍走 Paseo 原本的路徑。

ticks.zh: 過時的 revision 會拒絕
重複 id 不會再跑

caption.en: authorizeCoworkWrite runs for send_agent_message_request and create_agent_request. A managed target is refused when the revision or control epoch is stale, dispatch is held, the actor is not the writer, or the command id was already used. If the target is not registered, the call is allowed and the stock Paseo path continues. Of the 90 inbound write messages at this Paseo revision, the other 88 never call the gate.
caption.zh: authorizeCoworkWrite 會在 send_agent_message_request 與 create_agent_request 執行。受管目標如果 revision 或 control epoch 過時、派工被暫停、行為者不是寫入者，或 command id 已經用過，就會拒絕。目標沒有註冊時，這次呼叫會放行，並繼續走 Paseo 原本的路徑。這個 Paseo 版本的 90 種寫入訊息裡，其餘 88 種不會呼叫這個關卡。

heading.en: How the task journal survives a restart
heading.zh: 任務帳本怎麼熬過重啟

intro.en: The file under the daemon home is what the next process restores. An in-flight command is not sent again.
intro.zh: daemon home 裡的檔案，就是下一個行程還原的內容。還在執行的指令不會再送一次。

note.en: Writes are queued in call order so an older snapshot cannot land after a newer one.
note.zh: 寫入依呼叫順序排隊，較舊的快照不會蓋掉較新的。

note.en: The new body is synced to a temp file beside tasks.json, then renamed over it.
note.zh: 新內容先同步寫到 tasks.json 旁邊的暫存檔，再改名蓋過去。

note.en: On the next start, an in-flight command is marked unknown and is not sent again.
note.zh: 下次啟動時，還在執行的指令會標成 unknown，而且不會再送一次。

caption.en: The journal is cowork/tasks.json under the daemon home. Each save writes a temp file in that directory, syncs it, and renames it over the journal, so a crash leaves the old file or the new one. On startup, a command still marked in flight becomes unknown, dispatch is held, and the command is not sent again until the driver acknowledges it. The return rail is that later start reading the same file.
caption.zh: 帳本是 daemon home 下的 cowork/tasks.json。每次儲存都先把暫存檔寫在同一層、同步到磁碟，再改名蓋過帳本，所以中途當掉時留下的是舊檔或新檔。啟動時，仍標成執行中的指令會變成 unknown，派工先暫停，而且在主導者確認之前不會再送。圖上的回路是下一次啟動讀回同一個檔案。

heading.en: Why dispatch does not start a provider
heading.zh: 為什麼派工不會啟動供應者

intro.en: A catalog row or an adapter directory is not permission to run a provider. Every provider stays closed.
intro.zh: 目錄裡有一列，或磁碟上有 adapter，都不代表可以跑那個供應者。每一家都還關著。

note.en: assertProviderAdmitted throws for Claude, Codex, Grok, and Antigravity.
note.zh: assertProviderAdmitted 對 Claude、Codex、Grok 與 Antigravity 都會丟出錯誤。

note.en: Turns in the cowork tests come from an in-process fake Claude client.
note.zh: 協作測試裡的回合來自行程內的假 Claude 客戶端。

caption.en: cowork-core records Claude and Codex as adapter directories, Grok as an ACP catalog command, and Antigravity as not an agent provider. admittedForDispatch is false on every row. assertProviderAdmitted throws before a dispatch. The lanes stay unselected because none of them can be chosen. Test turns use an in-process fake Claude client.
caption.zh: cowork-core 把 Claude 與 Codex 記成 adapter 目錄，把 Grok 記成 ACP 目錄裡的指令，把 Antigravity 記成不是 agent 供應者。每一列的 admittedForDispatch 都是 false。派工前 assertProviderAdmitted 會丟出錯誤。圖上的路線都沒有被選中，因為沒有任何一家可以選。測試回合用的是行程內的假 Claude 客戶端。

heading.en: When a finished turn counts as verified
heading.zh: 做完的回合何時算驗證過

intro.en: Verification looks at git, not at a test result. The repair intent is recorded and not sent.
intro.zh: 驗證看的是 git，不是測試結果。修復意圖會被記下來，但不會送出。

note.en: settleCoworkTurn runs after a managed foreground turn, and it skips a paused or finished task.
note.zh: 受管的前景回合結束後會跑 settleCoworkTurn，暫停中或已結束的任務會跳過。

note.en: The task is verified only when HEAD moved past the last evidence commit and the tree is clean.
note.zh: 只有 HEAD 越過上一個證據 commit，而且工作樹是乾淨的，任務才算驗證過。

note.en: A pass stores the commit, the next failure after two counted attempts becomes a blocker, and the repair is not sent.
note.zh: 通過會記下 commit，兩次嘗試都算過之後的下一次失敗會變成卡關，修復不會送出。

caption.en: When a managed foreground turn finishes, settleCoworkTurn calls verifyTask unless the task is paused or already terminal. The check passes only when HEAD differs from the last evidence commit, or from the baseline commit if there is no evidence yet, and git status is clean. A pass records that commit. Failures increment rework, the default cap is two, and the following failure becomes a blocker. No test result is an input, and the repair intent returned with the failure is not dispatched.
caption.zh: 受管的前景回合結束時，只要任務不是暫停中或已經結束，settleCoworkTurn 就會呼叫 verifyTask。只有 HEAD 和上一個證據 commit 不同（還沒有證據時則和基準 commit 不同），而且 git status 是乾淨的，才算通過。通過會記下那個 commit。失敗會增加重做次數，預設上限是兩次，再下一次失敗就變成卡關。測試結果不是輸入，失敗時帶回的修復意圖也不會被派出去。
